note: Concise study outlines for common Sergeant paper themes — expand with official S.O./PSR/Act text in exams.

by_keyword.title: PSR 2007 — Reg 143 (Appearance & turn-out)
bullets: Cite Reg 143(1): properly dressed, clean, smart movements, respectful bearing in public.
On duty jewellery: wristwatch, allergy bracelet, max two rings — no other trinkets.
Male: short hair; chin/under-lip clean shaven; no whiskers; upper lip shave optional.
Female: hair not below nape; no unnatural colours/decorations; short nails; natural polish; minimal make-up.
Contrast with Reg 142: senior must NOT berate junior in presence of junior ranks or public (different issue).

by_keyword.title: S.O. 32 + Judges' Rules — Statements
bullets: Witness vs caution statement vs dying declaration — name all three from S.O. 32.
Standard caution: not obliged to say anything; what is said may be given in evidence — verbatim wording.
Children: parent/guardian; vulnerable adults: appropriate adult; foreign language: competent interpreter.
Judges' Rules are administrative directions; breach can affect admissibility — tie to fair trial/rights context.

by_keyword.title: S.O. 11 — Beat & patrol / briefing
bullets: Define beat vs patrol; seven modes including foot, mobile, canine, helicopter, etc.
Day 06:00–18:00; night 18:00–06:00; RED ink for night patrol register entries.
SDO Charge Room: adequate patrols, briefing content, checking Patrol Register.
Link to preservation of peace / detection duties under PSA functions.

by_keyword.title: S.O. 54 — Protests & demonstrations
bullets: Regional AC responsibility; Protest/Demonstration Register; Senior SDO assesses and notifies Area FDO.
Force must be necessary and proportionate; document warnings, routes, command decisions.
Balance lawful assembly with obstruction — cite Constitution ss.4(j) context briefly.

by_keyword.title: S.O. 53 + DVA Chap. 45:56
bullets: Duty to respond to ALL DV reports; DV register; SDO ensures Station Diary + prompt investigation.
Inform victim of rights/services; risk assessment mindset.
DVA powers of entry/arrest/protection orders — cross-check current consolidated Act on laws.gov.tt.

by_keyword.title: S.O. 38 — Charge Room
bullets: SDO-in-charge as custody officer for tour; Patrol Order 3 day / 4 night.
Enquire bona fides of every warrantless arrest; if unlawful — release, diary entry, inform FDO.
Inform prisoner of legal advice + communication rights; forbidden: leave without permission, sleep on duty, alcohol.

by_keyword.title: PSR Reg 191 — Communications
bullets: All communications to Commissioner go THROUGH senior officer in chain; senior must comment/advise.
Official letters to other government departments also route via Commissioner.
Contrast with horizontal coordination between peers at same level (still document formally when required).

by_keyword.title: Bail Act Chap. 4:60 — High level
bullets: s.5 + First Schedule Part I/II — Part II serious offences and three-conviction rule (10-year lookback).
Post-2024 murder bail no longer absolutely barred — Judge/Master exceptional circumstances (track current law).
120-day rule where no evidence taken — application to Judge.
Station bail (S.O. 10) only where Sergeant+ powers align with summary regime — do not exceed statute.

by_keyword.title: PSR Part XII–XIII — Conduct & discipline
bullets: Reg 150: know the 17 lettered offences (a–q) + breath/blood test under MVRTA when suspected intoxication.
Reg 142: senior must not berate junior in front of juniors/public — exam trap.
Suspension (full pay) vs interdiction (≥ half pay) when dismissal-level proceedings — fair hearing steps.

by_keyword.title: TTPS Strategic Plan 2025–2027 & Operating Plan 2026
bullets: Vision / Mission / Motto + six-part mandate + P.R.I.D.E. values — quote accurately.
FOUR pillars (not five): Community Partnerships; Organisational Development; Operational Excellence; Public Safety.
Strategic (3 yr) → tactical (Operating Plan annual KPIs) → operational (shift plans) cascade.

by_keyword.title: Management theory answers
bullets: Always name theorist + year; then APPLY with a TTPS station/patrol scenario.
Contrast Theory X vs Y; hygiene vs motivators; Mintzberg's three role families.
Contingency / situational leadership: match style to readiness and risk.
